{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=3|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Four people are injured in an overnight [[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] that struck an [[apartment building]] on [[Novorossiysk]], [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]]. The mayor of Novorossiysk declares a [[state of emergency]] following the strikes. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/05/3/7510394/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/05/03/russia-declares-state-of-emergency-at-port-after-ukrainian-drone-attack-on-novorossiysk (Al Arabiya)]
**The [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Main Directorate of Intelligence (Ukraine)|intelligence directorate]] claims it has shot down a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Sukhoi Su-30]] [[fighter jet]] using a [[MAGURA V5|MAGURA]] [[unmanned surface vehicle|naval drone]] over the [[Black Sea]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-intelligence-says-sea-drone-downs-russian-fighter-jet-in-world-first-strike/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
*** [[Hamas]] releases a video allegedly showing [[Israel]]i hostage Maxim Hirkin, who was abducted during the [[Nova music festival massacre]] in 2023, alive. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-releases-video-man-identified-gaza-hostage-2025-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-05-03/ty-article/.premium/hamas-releases-second-video-of-hostage-maxim-herkin-from-gaza-captivity/00000196-96e6-d19a-abfe-96f7b4110000 (''Haaretz'')]
*[[South Sudanese Civil War]]
**At least seven people are killed and 25 others are injured in an [[airstrike]] on a hospital run by [[Médecins Sans Frontières]] in Old Fangak, [[Fangak County]], [[South Sudan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/3/at-least-seven-killed-in-south-sudan-hospital-bombing-msf (Al Jazeera English)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/attack-on-hospital-run-by-doctors-without-borders-leaves-at-least-4-dead-in-south-sudan/ (CTV News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2536m9r2eo (BBC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese Civil War]]
**Twenty people are killed when a [[South Sudan Air Force]] [[Boeing 727]] carrying drones for the [[Rapid Support Forces]] is destroyed in an [[airstrike]] by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] at [[Nyala Airport]] in [[Nyala]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.sudanspost.com/south-sudanese-pilot-killed-in-saf-airstrike-on-rsf-operated-airport/ (Sudans Post)]  [https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/509028 (Aviation Safety Network)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Berkshire Hathaway]] [[CEO]] [[Warren Buffett]] announces that he will step down as CEO by the end of the year at the company's annual shareholder meeting. [[Greg Abel]] will take over as CEO, pending board approval. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/05/03/business/warren-buffett-berkshire-hathaway-meeting (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed and about 80 others are injured, including five critically, in a [[crowd crush]] during a [[Hinduism|Hindu]] [[Hindu temple|temple]] festival in  [[North Goa district]], [[Goa]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/3/crowd-crush-at-temple-in-indias-goa-kills-6-injures-dozens (Al Jazeera English)]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[Corruption in Brazil]]
**[[Brazil]]ian [[Ministry of Social Security (Brazil)|social security minister]] [[Carlos Lupi]] resigns after [[Law enforcement in Brazil|police]] announce a [[corruption]] scandal which alleges he [[fraud|defrauded]] [[pensioner]]s of $1.1 billion. [[Federal Police of Brazil|Federal police]] say that the [[National Social Security Institute]] made unauthorised deductions from payments made to millions of pensioners over the past decade. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0jz0wwgz95o (BBC)]
*A woman is killed in [[Thessaloniki]], [[Greece]], after a [[Improvised explosive device|bomb]] she was carrying explodes in her hands, also damaging several nearby storefronts and vehicles. The bomb was possibly intended to be placed outside a nearby bank. [https://apnews.com/article/thessaloniki-greece-bomb-explosion-4f7ff92f66cb2405e347f3b7e304a622 (AP News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Jalisco extermination camp]]
***José Murguía Santiago, the mayor of [[Teuchitlán]], Jalisco, is arrested on charges of organized crime and forced disappearance. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250504-mexican-mayor-arrested-in-probe-of-alleged-drug-cartel-ranch-govt-source (France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Australian federal election]]
**The [[Australian Labor Party]] under current Prime Minister [[Anthony Albanese]] increases its majority in the [[House of Representatives (Australia)|House of Representatives]], winning a second term. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-05-03/federal-election-night-2025-who-is-winning/105239714 (ABC News Australia)].
**[[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberal]] [[Leader of the Liberal Party of Australia|Leader]] [[Peter Dutton]] loses his seat of [[Division of Dickson|Dickson]], becoming the first [[Leader of the Opposition (Australia)|Leader of the Opposition]] to lose their seat in Australian electoral history. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-05-03/peter-dutton-losing-dickson-coalition-leadership/105247916 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[2025 South Korean presidential election]]
**Former [[Ministry of Employment and Labor|Labor Minister]] [[Kim Moon-soo (politician)|Kim Moon Soo]] wins the [[President of South Korea|presidential]] nomination of [[South Korea]]'s main [[Conservatism in South Korea|conservative]] party, [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-election-conservative-party-nominated-kim-moon-503473489b9daeb3785ab3ff9d5dee8e (AP News)]
*[[2025 Singaporean general election]]
**[[Singaporeans]] vote to elect 92 out of 97 members of the [[Parliament of Singapore]] across 32 of the 33 [[Constituencies of Singapore|constituencies]] in the [[general election]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/ge2025-polling-day-vote-general-election-5104111 (CNA)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/politics/singaporeans-head-to-the-polls-in-pm-wongs-first-election-as-leader (''The Straits Times'')]
**The [[People’s Action Party]] wins the election, receiving 65.57% of the vote. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/05/03/asia/singapore-ruling-party-election-win-intl-hnk (CNN)]
*[[Togo]]lese [[President of Togo|President]] [[Faure Gnassingbé]] is sworn-in as [[President of the Council of Ministers of Togo]]. Following [[constitutional reform]] that introduced a [[parliamentary system]], this new post becomes the highest office in the government's [[executive branch]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgjl9l9z7zjo (BBC)]
*Over 20,000 [[Hefazat-e-Islam Bangladesh|Hefazat-e-Islam]] protesters rally in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], to denounce proposed legislation that would [[Islamic feminism|provide equal rights]] for [[Muslim]] [[Women in Islam|women]] such as [[inheritance]] law, a ban on [[polygamy]], and recognition of [[sex workers]] as laborers, which they allege oppose [[Sharia law]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-women-rights-islamists-rally-114e1acbe56e7be75bc9b5273365a17a (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/bangladeshi-islamists-protest-womens-rights-proposal/a-72425960 (DW)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 Kentucky Derby]]
**In [[thoroughbred racing]], [[Sovereignty (horse)|Sovereignty]] ridden by [[Junior Alvarado]] wins the 151st [[Kentucky Derby]] in a upset over [[Journalism (horse)|Journalism]] ridden by [[Umberto Rispoli]]. [https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/horses/kentucky-derby/2025/05/03/sovereignty-pedigree-kentucky-derby-winner-horse-bio/79511749007/ (''Courier Journal'')]
